title: Offline neto2, longer training over three seeds: TD3+BC and IQL on neto1 v1 (7 heads) and neto1 v2 (27 heads)
description: exp-neto2-search-val-244 ranked 21 single-seed offline arms in closed loop on validation links. The one setting that clearly helped was training length: TD3+BC at alpha 5 for 60,000 steps in place of 20,000 was the best arm on both estimators (+0.015 on neto1 v1 and +0.029 on neto1 v2, mean log utility minus BBRv3, against +0.121 for the fixed rule on neto1 v1). Alpha between 5 and 20 changed little, the widened action range hurt, and IQL was level with TD3+BC on neto1 v2 only. This run follows the length: TD3+BC alpha 5 at 60,000, 200,000 and 600,000 steps, alpha 10 and IQL (expectile 0.7, beta 3) at 200,000 (experiments/specs/net2/offline-search2.json), each over training seeds 0 to 2 so that the spread between seeds can be told from the effect of a setting, on neto1 v1 (exp-net1-point-228) and neto1 v2 (exp-neto1-v2-239). Training only: the arms are compared in closed loop on validation links by a later experiment, and the test links select nothing.
run: N="$IN/$NET1/$(cat "$IN/$NET1/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; O="$OUT/neto2-$NET1-$ARM-s$SEED"; mkdir -p "$O"; jq -n --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --arg arm "$ARM" --argjson seed "$SEED" --slurpfile a experiments/specs/net2/offline-search2.json '{data: [$d], split_by: "link", seed: $seed, net1_from: $n, net2: $a[0][$arm]}' > "$O/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$O/train.json" "$O"; rm -f "$O/net1.pt"
collect: { echo "| arm | transitions | actions clipped | validation BC error | final diagnostics |"; echo "|---|---|---|---|---|"; for r in "$OUT"/neto2-*/report.json; do echo "| $(basename "$(dirname "$r")") | $(jq -r '[.net2.transitions, .net2.actions_clipped, .net2.val_bc_mse, (.net2.final | to_entries | map("\(.key) \(.value | tostring | .[0:7])") | join(", "))] | join(" | ")' "$r") |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
